extraction_method: Local FastMCP.list_tools() introspection with installed mcp 1.30.0 and Pydantic 2.13.5; TRENDS_BACKEND=official selected to avoid constructing network client. Full unconditional decorator registration and default trendspy implementations inspected. No tool invoked.
limitations: Remote endpoint behavior was not tested. Dependencies are range-pinned, so schema formatting may vary across supported MCP/Pydantic versions.
Official backend is a stub: every data method raises NotImplementedError. Default trendspy backend provides actual implementations.
Underlying trendspy dependency validation was not exhaustively inspected; wrapper/schema validation is reported.
reason: Eight Google Trends tools have complete locally enumerated schemas and real default-backend implementations, alongside one Autocomplete tool and one server-management tool. Warn about related endpoint quota failures and exclude official-backend deployment from functioning data providers.

tools.name: interest_over_time
tools.description:
Relative search interest over time for up to 5 terms (Google Trends' main chart).

Values are 0-100 within the query: 100 is the peak of the most popular
term in the requested period/geo. Passing multiple terms makes them
directly comparable to each other.

timeframe.description: Time range: 'now 1-H', 'now 4-H', 'now 1-d', 'now 7-d', 'today 1-m', 'today 3-m', 'today 12-m' (default), 'today 5-y', 'all', or explicit dates 'YYYY-MM-DD YYYY-MM-DD'.
timeframe.title: Timeframe

geo.description: Two-letter country code ('US', 'PT', 'GB') or region code ('US-CA'). Empty string = worldwide.
geo.title: Geo

category.description: Google Trends category ID to narrow results (0 = all categories). Use search_categories to find IDs.
category.title: Category

tools.behavior: Calls trendspy interest_over_time with up to five terms and returns relative 0–100 series, query context and scale note; caches for 12 hours.
validation_notes: All registrations are unconditional. No injected context parameters. Schema does not specify additionalProperties; no null types, enums, or pattern constraints are declared.

Default trendspy implementation has no additional explicit argument validation at this wrapper layer; Google/trendspy may reject unsupported strings. Official backend raises NotImplementedError for this tool.
Timeframe/geo/category values are descriptive guidance, not enum/pattern/range constraints; category has no minimum.
keywords minItems=1 and maxItems=5 are schema constraints; string items have no nonempty constraint. gprop options are prose only, not enum.

tools.name: keyword_ideas
tools.description:
Keyword research via Google Autocomplete: what people actually type into Google.

Reliable and fast (no Trends quota). Returns direct suggestions plus
expansions for intent modifiers (how/best/vs/why/near). Use this instead
of related_queries.

geo.description: Two-letter country code to localize results, e.g. 'PT', 'US'.
geo.title: Geo

tools.behavior: Requests Google Autocomplete directly for seed plus how/best/vs/why/near expansions; uses geo/language, caches 24 hours, returns suggestions without search-volume ranking.
validation_notes: All registrations are unconditional. No injected context parameters. Schema does not specify additionalProperties; no null types, enums, or pattern constraints are declared.

Default trendspy implementation has no additional explicit argument validation at this wrapper layer; Google/trendspy may reject unsupported strings. Official backend raises NotImplementedError for this tool.
Individual HTTP failures become empty suggestion lists; raises RuntimeError when all seed/expansion results are empty.
